text: {"repairs":[{"path":"analysis_steps[0].validation.evidence[0]","found":true,"loc":"Appendix: Emission maps in different rotational transitions","quote":"Here we present the emission maps of each individual line and discuss whether the different lines of a given species have brightness distributions significantly different among them"},{"path":"analysis_steps[2].fitting.evidence[0]","found":true,"loc":"Model, Chemical model: formation of carbon chains","quote":"For the purpose of reproducing the observed radial location of carbon chains, we have adopted a $N_{\\rm H}$ / $A_V$ ratio 1.5 times lower than the canonical interstellar value"},{"path":"analysis_steps[2].validation.evidence[0]","found":true,"loc":"Discussion","quote":"A comparison between the observed and calculated $\\lambda$ 3 mm emission distributions of carbon chains allows us to draw conclusions about the formation mechanism of carbon chains in IRC +10216."},{"path":"analysis_steps[3].method.evidence[0]","found":true,"loc":"Radiative transfer models: emission of carbon chains","quote":"The radiative transfer calculations have been performed with the multi-shell LVG code and physical model of IRC +10216 used by (cite: agu2012) (2012)"},{"path":"analysis_steps[3].assumptions[0].evidence[0]","found":true,"loc":"Radiative transfer models: emission of carbon chains","quote":"we have collapsed the fine rotational structure and simply treated these species as linear molecules with a $^1\\Sigma$ electronic state."},{"path":"analysis_steps[3].validation.evidence[0]","found":true,"loc":"Discussion","quote":"the observed brightness radial distributions are the result of an azimuthal average of the brightness distributions shown in Fig. [1](#fig:map_all)."},{"path":"reproducibility.data_public_as_stated.evidence[0]","found":true,"loc":"Footnote 1","quote":"This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.00432.S."}]}
